displayName: Iroquois Three Sisters (corn + bean + squash polyculture)
benefit: Traditional Haudenosaunee polyculture. Corn supplies the bean trellis; pole beans fix nitrogen for the next year's corn crop; squash vines shade soil, conserve moisture, and deter raccoons with spiny stems.

members.title: Plant pole beans at corn V3 stage
members.body: When corn is 6 to 8 inches tall, plant 4 pole bean seeds around each cornstalk, 4 inches from the stalk.

members.title: Plant squash hills at outer rows
members.body: Plant winter squash hills 36 inches apart on the outer rows of the corn block. Allow vines to run between corn rows.
